profile.headline: Software Engineer at PrecisionLender
profile.summary:
Software developer with five years of experience in the full software development lifecycle.
Front-end web development in ASP.NET and Angular
Application development with WinForms and WPF
Backend development in C#, C, C++, Java, Python, Javascript (Node.js with Express framework)
Strong familiarity with SQL, especially Microsoft SQL Server
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed WinForms applications and Windows services for servicing and interfacing with ignition interlock devices.
Developed frontend and backend code for an ASP.NET 4/MVC website for real-time reporting and client tracking.
Was solely responsible for designing, developing , and deploying updates to a TCP server for receiving and responding to cellular transmissions from ignition interlock devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on “CSI” team to resolve critical customer issues that required developer attention for a real estate closing, title and escrow product suite. Worked directly with support team and clients to resolve technical application issues and data inaccuracies.
Developed .NET utilities and scripts for support team.
Answered questions from third-party developers who were using SoftPro's API.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed middleware for pharmacy automation robots using WinForms. Worked on script parsing, data storage, client concurrency, and WCF communication.
Designed, developed, and maintained a retail adherence application in WPF.
Worked on a team using Agile software development methodology.

positions.title: Network Software Testing Intern
positions.description: Performed extensive performance testing of network management software. Used Wireshark and other tools to analyze network traffic and performance, and worked closely with developers to resolve bugs in production code. Wrote Python and Java scripts to automate testing procedures and to parse log files to report performance stats.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Monitored and collected data on traffic patterns in Atlanta on I-85 for an ongoing research project involving the conversion of High Occupancy Vehicle lanes to High Occupancy Toll lanes.

positions.title: Residential Technoolgy Advisor
positions.description: IT position; worked with a team in assisting students with setting up their TV, internet, and phone connections, and solving other computer-related issues.

positions.title: Engineering Assistant
positions.description: Assisted state inspectors in ensuring that proper technical and safety procedures were followed by road and bridge construction crews on several projects. Worked with one particular crew from the start to finish on a widening, resurfacing, and shoulder reconstruction project on a 6 mile stretch of NC-57.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Wrote Java and Perl scripts to migrate massive amount of biological research data from university database to NCBI public website. Modified Perl procedures and modules to upload large experiment data files into biological database. Carried out Perl CGI web programming for data retrieval, user management etc. Helped with data migration in clinical database and processing of sequencing data.
